fixes.reason: The pack read "" — no area at all — while the spell's first sentence is "A bright light emanates from you in a 10-foot radius". `emanationIsLive` asks /emanation/i of this string, so with it empty nothing followed the caster, no Region was placed, and no membership was ever computed. The whole spell had nowhere to happen.

The pack read `false`, so no active-spell entry was registered: no Magic-tab row, nothing for Sustain a Spell to target, and no emanation record — the record hangs off that entry. The spell says "At the beginning of each of your turns, you can Sustain the spell".

NOT "duration". Its printed duration is "1 minute (D)" — a flat clock — so `sustainedLapses` would have killed it two rounds after the last Sustain. "round" is the shape Lightning Storm and Spiritual Weapon already carry: the duration is the spell's own, and a Sustain buys the thing the text names. Here it buys a die or a point of bleed.

to.text: Light within the radius is increased by three steps.

fixes.reason: The effects array was EMPTY, so the spell healed nobody. `perTurn` is a fifth effect kind: not a bonus, a save, a floor or a growing circle, but an event on a clock — "all creatures that BEGIN THEIR TURN in the radius". Declared rather than parsed from the sentence, and the undead inversion is declared as a damage MODE with a type rather than as a negative heal, so it goes through the damage pipeline and meets resistances.

Graham's ruling, 29 August 2026: the Sustain ASKS each time. Declared on the entry so the picker is built from the spell rather than from a list in the workflow, and so the warp that lifts the cap has one place to lift it.
